dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon had no idea the Knights of Favonius had training dummies this huge!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: My father made this as a special collector's edition! I'm sure it'll prove worthy of your skills!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Haha, then let's give it a shot!
